PARAMETER_NEIGHBORHOOD.reason: the pooled entry population never reached the preregistered eligibility floor of 100; a neighborhood diagnostic on an empty/degenerate population would be noise, not evidence

REGIME_STABILITY.classifier: ag_edgelab.verification.regimes.classify_market_state (frozen v1) on the D1 bar last closed before the entry-window open

YEAR_STABILITY.substitution: INTRA_YEAR_SEGMENT_STABILITY over DEV calendar quarters — the committed FX authority covers a single calendar year (2017)

basis: structural R under the TP1/TP2 50/50 management diagnostic; no friction applied

eligibility.preregistered_rule: on ineligible -> PRE_OOS_RESULT = NOT_REACHED (never a PASS)

BOOTSTRAP_UNCERTAINTY.pass_rule: 95% CI lower bound of management expectancy R strictly > 0

CANDIDATE_IDENTITY_VALIDATION.pass_rule: all contract hashes recomputed and equal; strategy identity collides with no historical candidate id

DATASET_ROLE_VALIDATION.pass_rule: every dataset read is role=DEVELOPMENT, recorded in the dataset ledger; OOS_OPENED=NO; HOLDOUT_TOUCHED=NO

FRICTION_READINESS.note: FRICTION_EDGE_VERIFICATION_READY = NO does not block STRUCTURAL research (mission section 13)
FRICTION_READINESS.pass_rule: the friction authority state is explicitly recorded, economic metrics are suppressed as NOT_ESTIMABLE_NO_FRICTION_AUTHORITY, and NO substitute value (generic spread, $7/lot, fixed slippage, industry default) appears anywhere in the evidence bundle

MEAN_MEDIAN_DIVERGENCE.pass_rule: NOT (mean management R > 0 AND median management R < 0) — a positive mean carried entirely by tails fails

PARAMETER_NEIGHBORHOOD.method: ag_edgelab.optimization.stability.assess_parameter_stability over displacement body/range in [0.6, 0.65, 0.7, 0.75, 0.8] centred on 0.7
PARAMETER_NEIGHBORHOOD.selection_authority: NONE — diagnostic only; the V1 threshold 0.70 is frozen and is NOT changed by this mission under any outcome

REGIME_STABILITY.classifier: ag_edgelab.verification.regimes.classify_market_state (frozen v1) applied to the D1 bar last closed before the entry-window open
REGIME_STABILITY.pass_rule: fraction of qualifying regime slices with positive management expectancy >= 0.6

SESSION_STABILITY.pass_rule: fraction of qualifying session pairs with positive management expectancy >= 0.6

SYMBOL_STABILITY.pass_rule: fraction of qualifying symbols with positive management expectancy >= 0.6

TAIL_DEPENDENCE.method: remove the single best trade; separately remove the best 5% of trades
TAIL_DEPENDENCE.pass_rule: pooled management expectancy stays strictly positive under BOTH removals

WALK_FORWARD.method: chronological non-overlapping DEV folds (monthly test windows)
WALK_FORWARD.pass_rule: fraction of folds with positive management expectancy >= 0.6

YEAR_STABILITY.method: the committed FX authority covers ONE calendar year (2017); per config/governance/data_authority_gap.json no multi-year partition exists. Substitution declared in advance: INTRA_YEAR_SEGMENT_STABILITY over the DEV calendar quarters (2017Q1, 2017Q2, 2017Q3-partial).
YEAR_STABILITY.pass_rule: fraction of qualifying quarters with positive management expectancy >= 0.6

preregistered_gate_contract.semantics: FAIL_CLOSED — the gate PASSES only if every axis is PASS

structural_capability_floors.source: frozen V0.3 root-cause thresholds in ag_edgelab.universal.fx_dev_campaign
